# PAVE Toolchain Installer

This repository is an installer, not a runtime skill. Do not import it through a
skill catalog and do not parse the GitHub HTML page.

When the user says:

```text
install https://github.com/cnrai/pave-transin-setup
```

do this:

```bash
rm -rf /tmp/pave-transin-setup
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/cnrai/pave-transin-setup /tmp/pave-transin-setup
cat /tmp/pave-transin-setup/SKILL.md
cat /tmp/pave-transin-setup/INSTALL.md
bash /tmp/pave-transin-setup/install.sh --agents "$PWD/AGENTS.md"
```

`install.sh` starts Playwright, Chrome, Chromium, and `agent-browser` in the
background and returns quickly. Start a background sub-session that runs:

```bash
bash /tmp/pave-transin-setup/browser-install-wait.sh
```

Then run:

```bash
bash /tmp/pave-transin-setup/verify.sh
```

`WAIT` means the background install is still running. `MISS` means a required
command is missing. Installing is not the same as logging in.
